definition: Achievement goal theory is a framework for understanding how the kind of goals people pursue in achievement settings, such as mastery or performance goals and approach or avoidance aims, shape their attitudes and behavior. In this source, it is used to explain how these different goal patterns are linked to more or less ethical conduct in sport.
